## AC (b) EXECUTED — 387 of 389 duplicates closed

**Result, verified against live store state (not the run checkpoint):**

- **387 closed**, every one `close_class=duplicate` with a live `duplicates` link to its canonical.
- **0 closed against a wrong canonical**; 0 pointing at more than one canonical. 1 ticket (`regardable-bedridden-quillback` / `dca1-fb8c-4d3c-4913`) carries a redundant *identical* second link to its correct canonical — cosmetic, left in place.
- **Post-run sweep: 0 normalized-title groups with more than one still-open member** outside the `Condense comments` epic. The duplicate population is drained.
- **`Condense comments` epic untouched:** 1,616 tickets intact (1,499 closed / 117 open), **0** closed by this run.
- **2 deliberately left open** — `nauseating-inquiring-ibex` (`95da-0b4f-06a8-4b9c`) and `subjective-sudden-goitered` (`df55-1305-956e-431b`). Each holds legitimate non-duplicate open children (`02aa`, `2b0a`; `4f66`, `5165`) and rebar refuses re-parenting to their closed canonicals. Operator decision.

**No `--force`, no gate bypass, anywhere.** `--class duplicate` + live replacement link is the sanctioned path (`gates.py:150`) and mints a deterministic signed `completion-verifier` disposition attestation without an LLM pass.

**10 `ConcurrencyError` refusals**, all self-resolving — the store rejecting a transition on a ticket already in the intended state. All 10 verified to end `closed` / `duplicate` / correct canonical. All occurred in the resumed run, consistent with stale `open` reads across the run boundary. Zero non-concurrency failures.

Run: strictly sequential, ~51s/close, `REBAR_ROOT` on a throwaway worktree at `origin/main` (4c99403). Store consistent; no wedged locks.

**AC (c) — re-enabling the Reconcile Bridge — remains OPEN and is operator-gated.** The bridge is disabled, so none of these 387 closes has mirrored to Jira yet; REB issues will not reflect the disposition until it is re-enabled. Leaving this ticket `in_progress` on that basis.
